reply.summary: Naurau is a smuggler of frost weaponry who sells chilled ammunition to dockside crews. Entire harbours glaze white after one of its deals goes wrong, and rivals keep trying to steal the projector it carries.

feats.scene: Naurau flash-freezes a loading bay so hard that the steel doors shatter outward.
A thrown crate bounces off Naurau's padded coat without a bruise.

reply.summary: Lecorial is a frost-pistol thief who joins a cabal of showy villains and spends his days picking fights with a famous sprinter. He sulks, schemes and shoots ice with surprising patience.

feats.scene: Lecorial coats a whole rooftop in ice to trap a pursuing runner.
He shrugs off a bar stool broken across his back.

reply.summary: Llnti is a college student who gained flight and great strength after a glowing space rock burst over a campus quad. Llnti rushes into a foreign war that stronger heroes avoid, and pays dearly for the choice.

feats.scene: Llnti punches through a tank column and flips the lead vehicle into a barracks wall.
Llnti walks out of an artillery barrage with torn clothes and no wounds.
Llnti streaks across a river valley faster than the sound of the guns.

reply.summary: Valnorsiu is a masked wartime volunteer of average build who fights alongside a band of airborne heroes. Records are thin, but the mask and brisk marching voice made the figure a rallying sight for tired crews.

feats.scene: Valnorsiu kicks in a barricaded hatch with one boot.
Valnorsiu takes a rifle butt to the ribs and keeps advancing.

reply.summary: Valra is a scarred young commander in a ruined timeline who rallies the last survivors into an elite flying patrol. Valra carries a lifelong dread of causing the end, and the burden shapes every order given.

feats.scene: Valra drives a blade through a collapsed bulkhead to free trapped scouts.
Valra stands up from a falling girder that flattened the cart beside him.

reply.summary: Vavena is a licensed sea raider who only attacks other raiders, carrying papers signed by three distant governments. Vavena sails a fast brig and keeps a tidy ledger of every captured prize.

feats.scene: Vavena fires a broadside that splits the mast of a rival brig.
Vavena shakes off a cutlass slash across a heavy leather coat.

reply.summary: Tilirn is a one-handed sea bandit who dresses and swaggers like a buccaneer from centuries past. Tilirn raids freighters from a rusty boat and brags loudly about every haul.

feats.scene: Tilirn rams a patrol skiff and tears its side open.
Tilirn takes a boathook to the shoulder and laughs it off.

reply.summary: Celllnt is a daring aviator who flew combat sorties as a teenager and later roamed distant deserts in an open-cockpit biplane. Celllnt tosses grenades from the air and wins most fights by arriving at the right moment.

feats.scene: Celllnt dives and drops grenades that wreck a bandit fort gate.
Celllnt walks away from a crash landing in the dunes.
Celllnt pushes the old biplane through a canyon in a flat dive.

reply.summary: Sanos is an old-fashioned ship master who sails into puzzling disappearances and deaths with no marks on the bodies. Sanos leads through steady nerves, charts and a good ear for a lying sailor.

feats.scene: Sanos swings a belaying pin and drops a mutinous deckhand.
Sanos hangs on to a rigging line through a roaring gale.

reply.summary: Silmali is a veteran precinct chief in a quiet mountain town who quietly aids a shape-shifting visitor. Silmali is honest, tired and always one step behind the strange cases landing on the desk.

feats.scene: Silmali tackles a fleeing burglar over a parked sedan hood.
Silmali stays on his feet after a baton hits his forearm.

reply.summary: Nelaror is a hulking club-swinging villain who targets a teenage hero in a red suit. A single blow from the heavy club once put his young rival on the floor.

feats.scene: Nelaror smashes his club into a pier piling and snaps it in two.
Nelaror laughs as a thrown anchor rebounds from his chest.

reply.summary: Corna is a tentacled-submarine raider who rams cargo ships from beneath with a hydraulic spike and boards through the hollow shaft. Corna's armoured vessel dismantles hulls with giant claws and sinks everything it touches.

feats.scene: Corna drives the hydraulic spike through a freighter keel and splits it open.
Corna's hull holds against depth charges until a fuel tank finally ignites.

reply.summary: Rallicil is the restless ghost of an executed sea killer who hid his plunder and left a message in a bottle to stir trouble for centuries. Rallicil appears only as a green glow and a ghostly outline on a ruined deck.

feats.scene: Rallicil drags a green-lit bottle across open water toward a drifting skiff.
Rallicil's wraith passes unharmed through a volley of pistol shots.

reply.summary: Ceocorsti is a dark mirror-world bruiser in a black and gold costume who answers a boss's summons with thunder. Ceocorsti fights bigger and louder than most allies, then collapses under a faster water-dweller.

feats.scene: Ceocorsti calls down lightning that scorches a whole hangar floor.
Ceocorsti shrugs off a trident blow that would flatten a truck.
Ceocorsti flashes across a runway before the thunder reaches him.

reply.summary: Rniori is a young mirror-world enforcer in a black and gold costume with a fierce temper. Rniori breaks glowing constructs with bare hands and nearly finishes a rival before a screaming sound drops him.

feats.scene: Rniori punches a glowing barricade into pieces and sends the shards across the room.
Rniori stands through a fusion burst that cracks the wall behind him.

reply.summary: Vaial is a retired speedy hero turned classroom instructor, lampooning the idea of a heroic sprinter. Vaial still has some flying ability and quick legs, and a son who took the flying part.

feats.scene: Vaial vaults a lectern and tackles a runaway chalk robot.
Vaial takes a thrown textbook to the face and keeps lecturing.
Vaial blurs along a school corridor and arrives before the bell stops.

reply.summary: Amoriaeo is a grey-haired showman whose carnival tent covers a criminal crew's dealings. Amoriaeo once tried to display a shrunken heroine inside a glass jar to keep her out of the way.

feats.scene: Amoriaeo hurls a tent pole into a stage rig and brings it down.
Amoriaeo takes a tumbling barrel to the legs and limps onward.

reply.summary: Rerne is a long-lived blond swordswoman raised in a seaside abbey, granted a thousand years by a stranger's alchemy. Rerne guards ancient secrets, moves faster than ordinary guards, and seeks a forest guardian for help.

feats.scene: Rerne cleaves a fortress gate off its hinges with one two-handed stroke.
Rerne survives a collapsing tower floor and rises with only dust on her cloak.
Rerne outruns a cavalry charge across wet sand.

reply.summary: Lusanrn is a banished alien labourer who burned out on stimulants, caused a tragedy and joined an exiled general's army. Lusanrn later poses as a city guard officer and stages a bombing to win trust.

feats.scene: Lusanrn detonates a charge that gutted a headquarters wing.
Lusanrn climbs out of the rubble from the very blast she set.

reply.summary: Oravies is a gentle but formidable knight of a legendary round-table court who prefers peace to war. Oravies wears heavy plate and fights only when words fail.

feats.scene: Oravies parries a lance and drives the attacker out of his saddle.
Oravies stands as a mace rings off his helm.

reply.summary: Corsi is a poisonous gas robot who works with a twin to wear down a team of metal heroes. Corsi can flow through walls, fly, and spread choking fumes through a laboratory.

feats.scene: Corsi floods a lab with fumes that corrode a steel door.
Corsi disperses into vapour when a cannon shell passes through him.
Corsi streams down a corridor faster than any runner.

reply.summary: Llusi is a faceless vapour woman who joins a pack of gaseous criminals in a bright cartoon world. Llusi drifts through bars and walls, and moves quickly when the mood hits.

feats.scene: Llusi pours a toxic cloud through a vent and drops a vault guard.
Llusi reforms after a blast rips her form into wisps.

reply.summary: Sasluci is a masked enforcer in a grim, priestly regime who patrols a gloomy city with a partner. Sasluci relies on firearms and close fighting, and a careless moment ends the partnership in blood.

feats.scene: Sasluci empties a rifle clip through a barricaded door.
Sasluci rolls up from a fall through a shattered skylight.

reply.summary: Oream is a bald sea captain who built a living weapon and will do anything to get her back. Oream holds a hostage on a heavily armed deck until a mercenary and the weapon storm aboard.

feats.scene: Oream fires the deck cannon and tears a pier in half.
Oream keeps swinging after a steel pipe bends across his back.

reply.summary: Arletiu is a ruthless undead executive who murders a boss and plots to release a plague so victims become fresh food. Arletiu is clever and cold, but underestimates her successor's patience.

feats.scene: Arletiu drives a pen through a lock to slip into the sealed office.
Arletiu keeps walking after a thrown vase cracks across her cheek.

reply.summary: Nutelst is a greedy red-haired schemer who tried to harm a group of college girls with a caustic chemical. Nutelst keeps a couple of false names and is foiled by a heroine of myth.

feats.scene: Nutelst splashes a vat of acid over a laboratory bench and eats through the wood.
Nutelst stumbles out of a burning dorm hallway unharmed.

reply.summary: Niuol is an eight-foot dockworker turned monster after a carved idol made him immune to every blow. Niuol bulldozed a rival crimefighter until the idol was thrown into the sun, and later tried to go straight.

feats.scene: Niuol punches a cell wall until it crumbles and walks through the hole.
Niuol takes a collapsing crane across the shoulders and stands upright.

reply.summary: Rauralori is a wartime newshound who doubles as a masked spy and sea raider. Rauralori files articles by day and plots from a hidden vessel by night, always one headline from getting caught.

feats.scene: Rauralori fires a flare pistol that sets a dock crane aflame.
Rauralori rides out a hard slam against a bulkhead.

reply.summary: Rumis is a brilliant lock designer and security chief with a dangerous urge to build a cell nobody can escape. Rumis designs cages for the strongest prisoners and hides a dark fondness for captives.

feats.scene: Rumis triggers a cell mechanism that slams a reinforced door shut.
Rumis builds a vault that withstands a brutal hammering from a mighty hero.

reply.summary: Orronniu is a gifted lock expert who hatches a scheme to make money by freeing prisoners and sending them home, only to teleport them back into custody. Orronniu eventually ambushes a mighty hero with restraints that sap him.

feats.scene: Orronniu drops a ceiling gate that crushes a patrol car.
Orronniu absorbs a punch to the stomach and keeps scheming.

reply.summary: Taratau is the weary head of a famous island prison whose looks seem to change between appearances. Taratau keeps order, signs transfer papers and rarely leaves the control room.

feats.scene: Taratau pulls the alarm lever and locks down a whole cellblock.
Taratau stays upright after a riot shield catches him in the side.

reply.summary: Numtau is a sports hero and special-forces captain engineered into a super-soldier, then mind-altered into a clown's dull henchman. Numtau is strong and loyal, but terrible at jokes.

feats.scene: Numtau hurls a bar table across a club and splinters the far wall.
Numtau takes a rifle round to the chest and does not flinch.

reply.summary: Esiiar is a sibling-rivalry crime boss who nudges his brother into a fatal attack and then keeps the business for himself. Esiiar later wears a shadowy outfit that lets him slip through gaps.

feats.scene: Esiiar pushes a rival's car off a ramp into a canal.
Esiiar slips through a closing steel gate while shots pass by.

reply.summary: Renmiarn is a firearms-proficient adopted heir in a crystal-themed fantasy kingdom, with no magic and one missing hand. Renmiarn serves a sinister guardian, then turns toward gentler teachings and a throne.

feats.scene: Renmiarn fires a pistol that shatters a gem lantern across a hall.
Renmiarn endures a spell flash with nothing but a singed sleeve.

reply.summary: Ntses is a skin-changing villain who picks up a glove that boosts strength and cunning. Ntses lurks in the shadows of waterfront slums and leaves a niece to worry.

feats.scene: Ntses slams the glove into a steel locker and crushes the door.
Ntses takes a baton across the jaw and spits out a laugh.

reply.summary: Cortau is a tall obsessive thief who learned to turn into a flat, silent living shadow through a borrowed vest. Cortau slides through walls and ignores hits, but each use risks freezing the whole planet.

feats.scene: Cortau lifts a jewel case while sinking half-through a vault wall.
Cortau lets a thrown mace pass through his flat body harmlessly.

reply.summary: Torsirni is a museum burglar in a dark suit that turns him flat and untouchable. Torsirni teams up with two odd crooks to lift an alchemist's old book and is caught by a mystery-solving van crew.

feats.scene: Torsirni peels a display case lock with a gloved hand.
Torsirni sinks into a wall as a guard swings a fire axe through the space.

reply.summary: Rauorava is a crook who wears a dusky bodysuit to slip into places unseen. Rauorava may have sent a rock toward the planet as a distraction, and a tall heroine finally hauls him in.

feats.scene: Rauorava cuts a safe door in a shadowed corner and lifts the contents.
Rauorava lets a heavy fist pass through the flat shape of his torso.

reply.summary: Tetes is a blond matriarch who runs a rival crime ring in a windy city and mourns a murdered son. Tetes takes the killer's pistol and sets out to find the culprit in a long season of vengeance.

feats.scene: Tetes fires the recovered pistol and downs a hired gunman at the door.
Tetes keeps her composure as a window explodes beside her.

reply.summary: Cotorral is a determined city reporter who marries into the vigilante business and has sharp questions for any partner who transforms in front of her. Cotorral keeps a recorder handy and a quick comeback ready.

feats.scene: Cotorral swings a handbag and stuns a purse snatcher.
Cotorral stays upright through a jostling crowd at a stairwell.

reply.summary: Sticatel is a bored trophy hunter who believes every animal is too easy and travels to a dark city to hunt a masked man. Sticatel lays pit traps, wears disguises and shoots very well, until one of his own traps swallows him.

feats.scene: Sticatel fires a heavy rifle and drops a charging boar at long range.
Sticatel shrugs off a branch swat across the shoulders.

reply.summary: Iasri is a physician in a plague-ridden century who cannot catch the sickness and is distrusted for it. Iasri is one in a long chain of rebirths tied to an old curse.

feats.scene: Iasri sets a splint and shoves a panicked patient aside in a fever house.
Iasri sleeps among the dying and never takes ill.

reply.summary: Ausir is an ordinary tough with dark hair and brown eyes, tied to a rough crowd in a comic city. Few details survive, but Ausir shows up wherever a scuffle starts.

feats.scene: Ausir throws a punch that cracks a bottle on a counter.
Ausir takes a slap and keeps arguing.

reply.summary: Correr is a runway model whose latent talent woke under alien testing, giving her a skin-close shield that repels solids, liquids and air. Correr survived a deadly gauntlet and joined a band of fellow survivors.

feats.scene: Correr flares her field outward and hurls a squad of guards across a courtyard.
Correr holds her shield through a barrage of energy bolts that tears up the ground.

reply.summary: Ellleanu is a bald crime lord who bribes officials and tries to recruit a young heir into a shared grip on a city. Ellleanu loses everything when stolen files are turned against him and a masked vigilante visits his penthouse.

feats.scene: Ellleanu orders a squad to open fire on a warehouse and shreds the doors.
Ellleanu endures a hard shove into his own desk.

reply.summary: Lournll is a white-haired mob patriarch with scarred cheeks, a love of cooking and a long list of dead relatives. Lournll leads through calm menace and a quick trigger finger.

feats.scene: Lournll fires a pistol and shatters a restaurant mirror behind a rival.
Lournll sits through a hail of glass and finishes his meal.

reply.summary: Anicorle is a burned test pilot who builds an underwater flying carrier and a network of air raiders to avenge a wrecked career. Anicorle's rays pulverise warships from many miles away, until fire consumes his flagship.

feats.scene: Anicorle fires a ray from the carrier that pulverises a battle cruiser on the horizon.
Anicorle's carrier takes cannon fire for an hour before the fuel catches.

reply.summary: Rivillo is a warm-hearted circus barker who convinces performers to pose as celebrated heroes when funds run low. Rivillo guides spectators to safety during an attack and earns a steady job from a charity.

feats.scene: Rivillo cranks open a jammed tent flap and ushers children out.
Rivillo stays on his feet as a toppled stand clips his back.

reply.summary: Corll is a purple-haired alien soldier stranded after her invasion ship crashed in a field of rocks. Corll is recruited with a toxin, joins a riot downtown and is shot dead by a police chief.

feats.scene: Corll hurls a squad car door through a shop window.
Corll survives the crash of her fleet ship and crawls out of the wreck.

reply.summary: Iairtel is a cheerful robot caretaker of an abandoned amusement park who has no special gifts but plenty of schemes. Iairtel joins a gang of tyrants for fun and blows up the park to destroy a visiting team.

feats.scene: Iairtel detonates every robot in the park in one huge blast.
Iairtel's casing holds together as a ride collapses overhead.
